name: Euro-area economy
summary: Euro-area GDP +0.4% in Q3, though France contracted; PMIs softening
state: Eurostat's flash estimate on 30 Oct showed euro-area GDP up 0.4% in Q3, though French output contracted. October flash PMIs (23 Oct) showed expansion weakening, and the ECB warned on 29 Oct that energy prices pose downside risks to growth. Final October PMIs are due from 2 Nov; neither stagnation nor a sub-50 composite is yet confirmed.
for_you: Europe is still growing, but the energy shock is beginning to bite. A slowdown there would weigh on UK exports.
rubric_hit: Positive GDP (+0.4% q/q) and composite PMI above 50

sources.title: Agence Europe — Euro area GDP estimated to have risen by 0.4% in third quarter

why: The euro area is the UK's largest trading partner; stagnation there hits UK exports and European markets.
drivers: Energy prices, German industry, ECB policy, fiscal rules, China demand.

rubric.alert: Technical recession, or PMI < 45, or bond-spread fragmentation forcing ECB action.
rubric.normal: Positive GDP growth and composite PMI > 50.
